## c0d024631f9e

**Issue found — advertised controls are dead or impossible.** `third_color_pick` is never consumed: for 20 matched seeds/indices, `third_color_pick="random"` and `third_color_pick="specific"` produced byte-identical grids in 20/20 cases. The `placement_pattern` contract advertises `random|clustered|striped|quadrants|banded`, but only `random` can execute. Each of the other four values failed 20/20 attempts with, for example, `ValueError: draw_choice('placement_pattern'): override 'striped' not in options`.

The immediate cause is eager evaluation of the default expression in `overrides.get("placement_pattern", ctx.draw_choice(... list(HELPFUL_TEXTURES)))`: `HELPFUL_TEXTURES` contains only `random`, so `gen_ctx` validates an explicit override against the wrong one-value domain before `_place_with_pattern` sees it. This is a reproducible exact-control counterexample, not a stylistic concern. Either remove unsupported axes, or draw/validate against the full declared domains and add observable tests for the intended rank-3 color selection.
